notes.title: v3.1.11 Update
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes: 
[list]   
[*]Destiny has a brand-new look.[/*]   
[*]Aarin Lohar, the town blacksmith, can now forge copper, iron, silver, or gold keys for you. They will be used to unlock secret doors and open locked chests.[/*]   
[*]In the landing, woods, and dungeons, chests that have a chain wrapped around them have been replaced with chests without a chain. In the future, chests with a chain wrapped around them will represent locked chests.[/*]   
[*]A couple of secret doors have been added (if we said where, they wouldn't be secret), as well as a locked chest. There will be more in the future.[/*]   
[*]The exit doors in the Guild Dungeons have been changed from wooden trap doors to ladderways with sliding concrete covers that better befit a dungeon.[/*]   
[*]Performance enhancements were made to the actor and item information systems.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.10 Update
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes: 
[list]
[*]The shipping container display has been completely revised. It is now possible to see what is in the shipping container and what is in your inventory side by side, and to move items back and forth between them, up until midnight when the shipping container is emptied, and the items in it sold.
[*]Brendylynn has had a fashion makeover, and now wears clothes that are much more appropriate for the rugged adventures she faces. 
[*]If the HUD was displayed, and the PAUSE button was clicked during a battle, when the game was resumed, the HUD would display during the battle. This has been fixed. 
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.9 Update
notes.notes:
The following changes are included in this update:
[list]
[*]The inventory display has been completely revised. It is now displayed as a grid, as in most other games. The same changes have been made to the shipping container display.
[*]Zeph, who guards the East entrance of the Market, would always wish you a good evening when you left the market after it closed, even if it was actually morning. He now wishes you a good morning, evening, or night, as appropriate.
[*]A problem where multiple functions were trying to use the same picture IDs at the same time, causing pictures to disappear seemingly randomly, was fixed.
[*]The system that controls the gates in the Market was streamlined and made more reliable.
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.8 Update
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes: 
[list]
[*]The previous update introduced an error where the dates of holidays in the Encyclopedia showed the day of the week instead of the month. This was fixed. 
[*]High Priestess Tulsi's responses to new scrolls from Brendylynn were increased in number, so as to avoid tedium. 
[*]The logic for processing quests and scrolls was completely refurbished, giving much more stable, predictable, and maintainable results.
[*]Sleep processing whether due to going to bed, taking a nap, collapsing from hunger, thirst, or exhaustion, or returning from delivering a scroll to High Priestess Tulsi, has been standardized, and problems with dialog starting before the scene has faded in   have been fixed. 
[*]Interacting with NPCs has changed. Previously, when you talked to an NPC, you got list of choices for how you wanted to interact, with one of them being "Nevermind". Now there are several icons to the right of the message box for things like chat, open shop, give a gift, ask what gifts they like, and ask them to join your party. Any icons that are not available are grayed out. Instead of having to select the "Nevermind" choice when you don't want further interaction, you can just press the enter key to dismiss the message box.
[*]Several NPCs did not hide the HUD while they were talking, which made the dialog hard to read. This has been corrected. 
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.7 Update
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes: 
[list]
[*] Changed NPCs to occasionally mention when it is a holiday. 
[*] Recovered day-of-week names.
[*] When a formatted date is given, as in Destiny's "Good Morning" messages, it now includes the day of the week, for example, "Ihud, Terr 1, 1414". The days of the week are Ihud, Sanno, Maksanno, and Rabu. Rabu is a Holy day. 
[*] When Brendylynn wakes up in the morning, there is now a toast message if the current day is a holiday.
[*] The shipping container was still referred to as the "Recycle Bin" in a few places. This has been fixed. 
[*] The following Visustella plugins were updated to the latest version: 
   - 8 Waves Collection
   - Battle Technician Vol 1
   - Custom Construct Vol 1 to 3
   - Dungeon Divers
   - Merchant Manager Vol 1 and 2
   - Visual Novel Vol 1
   - Wanderlust 
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.6 Update
notes.notes:
This update contains the following changes: 
[list]
[*] Removed "What is your favorite gift?" from NPC dialogs. They now tell you from time to time.
[*] Completely revised the dialog with Destiny in Brendylynn's house to fix some edge conditions.
[*] Revised Destiny's good morning messages, so she doesn't say the same thing all the time. 
[*] When Brendylynn collapses from hunger, thirst, or lack of stamina. She now actually collapses, and lays there for a few seconds before we fade to black. 
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.5 Update
notes.notes:
This update includes the following changes: 

[list]
[*] NPCs no longer introduce themselves every time you talk to them. The first time you converse, they       tell you their name and role (class). After that, they greet Brendylynn by name. But don't worry about remembering their names; it's always at the bottom of the message box. 
[*] Elenor Fant, the quest giver, no longer delivers a long speech when she offers you the first quest,       "Meet the neighbors", listing all of your neighbors. You can see who you have met and who you have yet to meet by turning on tracking for the quest. 
[*] Lipiers, the guardsman who protects the Ruben Inn, now has a new, more handsome avatar. 
[*] A new guardsman, Zeph, now protects the Market after hours, so Lipiers doesn't have to pull a double shift. 
[*] The gates in the Market have been reworked, so they open and close when the Market does, rather than waiting until someone tries to go through them.
[*] The Market vendors who stand in front of their booths, Dagmar, Ekantika, Burgwy, Berctio, and       Florenz Bartone, now go home and get some rest when the Market closes, rather than standing      around the Market all night long. 
[*] Message boxes now shrink to fit the size of the message, giving a cleaner look. 
[*] The Market map has been made slightly wider, making the entrance road less claustrophobic while you are waiting for the market to open. 
[*] The Hero's Chamber (High Priestess Tulsi's office) has been made a bit wider.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when claiming the reward for the first quest, you were presented with the PARTY screen, instead of a picture of the quest giver. 
[*] The way NPCs are defined internally has been revised and streamlined, which will make for fewer errors when changing NPCs or introducing new ones. 
[*] Several minor bugs were fixed.  
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.4 Update
notes.notes:
This small update includes the following changes: 
[list]
[*] Updated RPG Maker MZ engine modules to 1.7 version.
[*] Changed GUI to use proper type face for clock and gold display.
[*] Tuned chests to give 50 or 100 gold, rather than 100 or 500, give one item, rather than three, and to give only one of that item. 
[*] Changed splash screens to display for 30 seconds, rather then 20, to allow them to be fully read. 
[*] When Brendylynn entered the woods from the landing, or Ruben from the woods, her entrance was covered up by the HUD. Her entry point was adjusted to make her entry visible. 
[*] When you talk to Kishen, there is a 40% chance that he will steal 5% of the gold you are carrying. 
[*] Renamed the recycle bin the shipping container,  to reflect that fact that it can be used to  sell crafted goods for gold, rather than  just discards.  
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.3a - Re-upload due to copy problem
notes.notes: This update is just a re-upload of the v3.1.3 update in order to fix a problem that occurred during the copying of the files.

notes.title: v3.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
The big news for this update is the new banking system. You can now deposit your hard-earned gold in the Ruben Bank to protect it from thieves, pickpockets, and ne'er-do-wells, while earning interest. Your deposit earns 3% simple interest per month, calculated daily and paid monthly. 

Other enhancements: 
[list]
[*] The current date is now displayed on the HUD, underneath the current time. 
[*] Daytime now begins at 8 am, rather than noon, to provide more hours of daylight.
[*] The default type face for the game has been changed to Gill Sans.
[/list]

notes.title: 3.0 Upgrade
notes.notes:
The game has been revised for a better user experience. Check it out. Now!

[list]
[*] Fixed bad path to one of the beds in the Ruben Inn that would get Brendylynn stuck.
[*] Updated Aarin Lohar, the blacksmith, with improved avatar images.
[*] Added 150 icons for food items.
[*] Enlarged the menu for the Ruben Inn restaurant to include all cooked food items.
[*] Added rewards to all the achievements.
[*] Improved the messages when an achievement is earned to show the name and icon of the reward. 
[*] Completed the quest system. It is now possible to get all 40 scrolls.
[*] Added a "PARTY" button to the GUI, to bring up the party-changing scene.
[/list]

notes.title: Update for May 2nd, 2023
notes.notes:
This update, Release 2.9.2, brings the following changes: 

[list]
[*] Fixed off-by-one error in friendship journal display.
[*] Fixed a few chests in the dungeons that were still running the old firmware, causing confusing messages.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Dev Blog: Major Update Dev Notes[/h1]
Added a number of features, including friendship system, hunger/thirst system, and
over 100 new items. 

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the color scheme for the HUD and message boxes from green to transparent gray.
[*] Improved aesthetics and operation of the prologue pages.
[*] Upgraded coin icon when gold is found
[*] Improved message box and HUD frames.
[*] Changed the gold display to show zero, rather than blank, when you have no gold.
[*] Changed the treasure chests to display a picture or icon of the treasure, when available.
[*] Added dozens of pictures for items, weapons, and armor. 
[*] Added an introduction to the chest, dresser, and journal features in Brendylynn's house the first time they are used.
[/list]

[h2]Game Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed NPCs that had generic names. 
[*] Added an [i]escape[/i] option for battles with wolves in the Woods map.
[*] Added fog-of-war to the dungeons under the Guild Hall.
[*] Added lights to the dungeons under the Guild Hall.
[*] Added battle statistics for elemental rings. 
[*] Changed sleep and nap functions to advance time to 6:00 am the next day. 
[/list]

[h2]New Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completely revised the day/night tinting system, to make outdoor lighting appropriate for the time of day.
[*] Added a hunger/thirst/stamina system. 
[*] Added a friendship journal and display.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed broken interactions with NPCs in Market square.
[*] Fixed broken chests in Guild Hall basement.
[*] Fixed regions for wolves in the Woods map, so they can move around.
[/list]
